title: Maximum Product of the Length of Two Palindromic Substrings
description: Find two non-overlapping palindromic substrings such that the product of their lengths is maximized.
pseudocode:
1. Run Manacher's to get max palindrome radius at each center
2. Compute L[i]: max length palindrome ending at or before i
3. Compute R[i]: max length palindrome starting at or after i
4. Iterate split point i to maximize L[i] * R[i+1]

steps.note: Compute L array (max palindrome ending at or before index i)
Compute R array (max palindrome starting at or after index i)
Calculate product L[i] * R[i+1] for split point i=1
Calculate product L[i] * R[i+1] for split point i=2
